decision: the app edits lanhub.toml with toml_edit: each edit re-reads the file, changes only its [[project]] table, validates the whole text with lanhub_core::config::parse, writes it with flush::write_file_atomic, then calls AdminApi::apply_config with the parsed Config
why: A4 left validation of hand-built configs to A7; parsing the written text runs the hub's own checks, and editing in place keeps comments and keys this version does not know (A5 history, A6 TLS and public_address)
evidence: lanhub/app/src-tauri/src/config_file.rs; tests/commands.rs update_keeps_the_token_and_keys_the_form_does_not_show, a_file_that_does_not_parse_is_never_overwritten
result: 8 app tests pass

decision: core edits limited to: ProjectStats counters (files, ops, last_activity) kept by the actor and read in ProjectStatus (ops, lastActivity, live files), and config::normalize made pub
why: the cards need live file count, last activity and an ops rate without a round trip to the actor; normalize lets the form compare folders the way the parser does; no join or leave event was needed because the 500 ms sample reads the member counter
evidence: lanhub-core project.rs, registry.rs, config.rs diff
result: cargo test --workspace passes

decision: status view: one task samples AdminApi::list_projects every 500 ms, wakes early on Registry::subscribe events but never samples twice within 500 ms, computes ops per second over a 10 s ring per project run, and emits hub-status to the window and the tray only when the snapshot differs
why: plan box: at most every 500 ms and only on change; the rate decays without new ops, so it is resampled rather than event driven
evidence: lanhub/app/src-tauri/src/status.rs, main.rs status_loop
result: lane 10: 2 changes per second during the ramp, steady 400 matches loadgen opsPerSec

decision: the window logic lives in the LanHub binary (main.rs, commands.rs, tray.rs); config_file, service, status and i18n form a lib that does not link Tauri; the bin test target is off
why: a test binary that links Tauri on Windows lacks the comctl32 v6 manifest and dies with STATUS_ENTRYPOINT_NOT_FOUND (0xc0000139); the plan's tests/commands.rs therefore drives AppCore, which each Tauri command wraps one to one
evidence: cargo test -p lanhub-app before the split: exit 0xc0000139
result: deviation from "calls each Tauri command": the commands are thin wrappers over the tested AppCore methods
